blind_read: The monkey broke a toothed part in two, then looked up at the red cross and froze with a half in each fist.

evidence.observation: The hands close around opposite sides of the toothed part, then a space opens between the halves under the error badge. The shape of the gear and the red cross both survive at native size.

The wide eyes turn up toward the X. Two lines inside the detached-side fist (y34 and y37), the foot soles (y54), and a pixel in the badge itself (y15) change with the coat. The hand stripes are particularly conspicuous against warm skin.

blockers: The fur ramp colors the skin inside the far hand, the flat soles and part of the red badge.
